objectives.title: Third Country Transfer Safeguards
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding required transfer safeguards.
criteria: Provisions establishing enforceable data subject rights.
Provisions establishing effective legal remedies for data subjects.

objectives.title: Standard Data Protection Clauses
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding standard transfer clauses.
criteria: Provisions incorporating standard data protection clauses adopted by the Commission.
Provisions incorporating standard data protection clauses adopted by a supervisory authority and approved by the Commission.

objectives.title: Ad Hoc Contractual Safeguards
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding individually authorized contractual clauses.
criteria: Provisions incorporating supervisory authority authorized contractual clauses.
Terms governing recipient obligations in third countries.
Clauses establishing recipient obligations in international organisations.

objectives.title: Code of Conduct and Certification Transfer Safeguards
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding code of conduct or certification-based transfer safeguards.
criteria: Provisions incorporating an approved code of conduct pursuant to Article 40 as a transfer safeguard.
Provisions incorporating an approved certification mechanism pursuant to Article 42 as a transfer safeguard.
Binding and enforceable commitments to apply the safeguards, including as regards data subjects' rights.
